checkpoints.description: [1/4] Add read-only target facts and adapters for the eight requested games

impact_assessment.why: Foundry is a shared content pipeline but only crypt-crawler is a registered consumer; the user asked to add After Image, Aldervale, Shooter, Weft, Iris, Primordia, Cyberpulse and Fold as targets without editing those projects.
impact_assessment.benefits: One registry exposes each target's project root, lifecycle, engine, test command and authored content surfaces; static read-only extraction keeps the consumer projects untouched and catches drift.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new target schema and registry API; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: generated target manifests under targets/ plus foundry ledger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Read sources statically (JSON/AST/regex), validate paths and counts in tests, prove each consumer git tree stays clean, run foundry unittest suite and aikit check.
